author: KEXP
description: Lisbon trio MAQUINA. explore the boundaries of krautrock and industrial techno to create an electrifying live experience charged by raw power. On our trip to @transmusicalesOfficiel, the group showcased their sound with a performance of "kontakte" and more.
title: MAQUINA. performs "kontakte" and more Live on KEXP from @transmusicalesOfficiel
